chunks: Hisham ibn al-Hakam narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If a man marries a woman for her wealth or her beauty, he will not be granted that. But if he marries her for her religion, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will grant him her beauty and her wealth.

key_terms.رَزَقَهُ: Allah provided him with or granted him
key_terms.لِدِينِهَا: for her religion; for her piety and religious commitment
key_terms.لِمَالِهَا: for her wealth; making financial gain the motive for marriage

ai.seo_question: Why does this hadith recommend marrying for religion rather than wealth or beauty?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that marriage should be founded primarily upon religion rather than worldly attraction or wealth. It emphasizes that when one gives priority to din, Allah عزّ وجلّ places blessing in the marriage and may also grant the worldly qualities one did not make the basis of the union.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4380 - Hisham ibn al-Hakam narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:

"If a man marries a woman for her wealth or her beauty, he will not be granted that. But if he marries her for her religion, Allah (swt), the Almighty and Glorious, will grant him her beauty and her wealth."
